# Profile — Quick Start Commands
# Run these in order. After each step, copy generated files to your project repo.

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: Code Generation
# Use make commands to generate skeletons for each layer.
# ============================================================

# Controller
php artisan make:controller ProfileController

# Model
php artisan make:model Profile

# Migration
php artisan make:migration create_profiles_table

# ============================================================
# STEP 2: Move Generated Files
# Laravel puts generated files in default locations.
# Move them into the correct module folders before editing.
# ============================================================

# app/Http/Controllers/ProfileController.php  →  Profile/Apis/ProfileController.php
# app/Models/Profile.php                      →  Profile/Models/Profile.php
# database/migrations/..._create_profiles_table.php  →  Profile/Migrations/

# ============================================================
# STEP 3: Implement
# Fill in each file following the rules in RULES.md.
# ============================================================

# Profile/Models/Profile.php         — fillable, casts, relationships
# Profile/Repos/ProfileRepository.php     — Eloquent queries only
# Profile/Services/ProfileService.php     — business logic, inject repo
# Profile/Apis/                          — add external API clients if needed
# Profile/Migrations/                    — implement up() and down()

# ============================================================
# STEP 4: Database Management
# Run migrations and seed test data.
# ============================================================

# Run all pending migrations
php artisan migrate

# Seed test data (optional)
php artisan db:seed --class=ProfileSeeder

# ============================================================
# STEP 5: Copy to Project Repo
# Only copy reviewed, working code.
# ============================================================

# Checklist before copying:
# [ ] Code reviewed and tested locally
# [ ] Migration runs cleanly (php artisan migrate)
# [ ] All down() methods implemented
# [ ] No hardcoded credentials or .env values in code
# [ ] Files placed in correct folder structure in target repo
